Package com.hiface.sdk.verification

Class FaceVerificationConfig

java.lang.Object
com.hiface.sdk.verification.FaceVerificationConfig
public final class FaceVerificationConfig extends java.lang.Object
Settings for one dynamic 1:1 verification. The reference feature is required and is supplied through FaceVerificationConfig.Builder.referenceFeature(String) with the other settings.

Actions are optional: zero actions enters the final stage directly. Passive liveness is also controlled by an explicit switch. When enabled, it runs with 1:1 verification on the same frames; the application does not need to create or chain a separate liveness request. Configure face-acquisition timeouts and the multiple-face policy directly in this Builder.
